title: How to Check if ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity Mention Your Business (UK Guide)
meta_title: How to Check if ChatGPT Mentions Your Business (UK)
meta_description: A free 20-minute test to see whether ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity recommend your business, how to track it monthly, and what to fix if they don't.
keywords: check if chatgpt mentions my business

faq.q: How do I know if ChatGPT recommends my business?
faq.a: Ask ChatGPT the questions your customers ask, in a fresh logged-out chat, and see whether your business is named. Repeat across several questions and record the results.

faq.q: Why does ChatGPT recommend my competitors and not me?
faq.a: Usually because competitors are mentioned on more trusted sites (reviews, directories, best-of lists) and have clearer pages answering the exact question.

faq.q: How often should I check AI visibility?
faq.a: Monthly is enough for most small businesses. AI answers change, so compare the same prompts each month.

faq.q: Can I see ChatGPT traffic in Google Analytics?
faq.a: Yes, as referrals from chatgpt.com and similar domains, but many AI answers send no click, so GA4 shows only part of the picture.

faq.q: Do Gemini and ChatGPT give the same answers?
faq.a: No. Each assistant uses different sources and can name different businesses, so test all the main ones.
